settings.title: The whole setup
settings.text: Showerhead, 1.5 m hose, arm adapter with holder, thread tape, and 5 filter cartridges, all in one box.

settings.title: Replaceable cartridge
settings.text: Five cartridges are included. Refills are sold separately, so you only replace what wears out.

settings.title: Soft massage nozzles
settings.text: A ring of silicone bristles around the spray face, with three spray settings.

settings.title: Refills that stay cheap
settings.text: A 3-pack of refill cartridges is $19.99, about $6.66 each.

settings.label: In the box
settings.us: Head, hose, arm adapter, tape, 5 cartridges

settings.title: Unscrew
settings.text: Remove your current showerhead from the shower arm.

settings.title: Adapt
settings.text: Wrap the tape around the arm's thread and screw on the adapter.

settings.title: Connect
settings.text: Attach the hose to the adapter and the showerhead to the other end.

settings.title: Rest and flush
settings.text: Set the head in the holder, run the water for 30 seconds, then shower as normal.

settings.a: Yes. The Complete Set includes the showerhead, a 1.5 m hose, an arm adapter with a built-in holder, thread seal tape, and 5 cartridges. If you want to keep your own hose, choose the showerhead and cartridges only.
It is made for standard shower arms. If it does not fit, message us and we will sort it out.

settings.q: How often do I change the cartridge?
settings.a: Every 2 to 3 months, depending on how much you shower and what your water is like.
Orders ship in 7 to 15 business days.

settings.subhead: A handheld showerhead with soft massage nozzles, a hose, an arm adapter with holder, and a replaceable filter cartridge system. Everything you need, in one box.
settings.marquee: Complete shower setup  *  Soft massage nozzles  *  Refills from $6.66  *  Hose and adapter included  *
settings.choose_sub: Get the complete setup, or keep your hose and add the head and cartridges.
settings.math_text: That is what a fresh cartridge costs when you buy the 3-pack of refills at $19.99 and swap one every 2 to 3 months.
settings.final_sub: The Complete Set has the showerhead, hose, arm adapter, tape, and 5 cartridges, about a year of use.
